Definition
[Berger's list of irreducible holonomy groups]

Source: petersen:page-0401 For a simply connected irreducible Riemannian $n$-manifold whose holonomy acts transitively on the unit sphere of $T_pM$, the possible holonomy groups $\mathrm{Hol}_p$, and the resulting geometric structure, are:

$\dim =n$

$\mathrm{Hol}_p$

properties

$\mathrm{SO}(n)$

$n=4m$

$\mathrm{Sp}(1)\cdot \mathrm{Sp}(m)$

$n=4m$

$\mathrm{Sp}(m)$

$n=16$

$\mathrm{Spin}(9)$

symmetric and Einstein

$n=7$

$G_2$

Ricci flat
